title: EXPERIENCE
heading: Experience from projects and programs I've taken part in

items.desc: Quality assurance for a cloud automation platform — designed and executed test cases, performed functional and regression testing, cross-browser validation, and API testing. Automated regression suites with Playwright, reported and tracked bugs, and maintained test documentation.

Built a bilingual portfolio platform with a self-hosted admin panel — Next.js frontend, API backend with authentication and CRUD, SQLite storage, Dockerized and deployed via GitHub Actions — plus a fully static version live at afadfath.net.
Built the backend of a police scheduling management platform — REST API with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and SQLAlchemy, secured with JWT authentication and documented with Swagger/ReDoc.
Developed the backend of an online counseling platform connecting students with counselors: REST API with Node.js, Express, Sequelize, and PostgreSQL, documented with Swagger.

Machine Learning path of Bangkit — a career readiness program led by Google with GoTo and Traveloka under Indonesia's Kampus Merdeka initiative. Focused on machine learning and data science through an industry-designed curriculum, mentoring, and practical projects.
